lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗?

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说什么?

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, that’s fair. She’s way better than me at essentially everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，这倒是公平。她基本上在所有事情上都比我强太多了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hahah. I’m only kidding, Sensei :) You’ll always be my favorite{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈哈。我只是开玩笑的，Sensei :) 你永远都是我的最爱{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But I have grown really fond of Miss Imai. She’s so amazing and beautiful and inspiring.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过我越来越喜欢 Imai 老师了。她是那么了不起、那么美、那么鼓舞人心。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Did something happen?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}发生什么事了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes :) But we decided to keep it a secret, so I can’t tell you :P{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有啊 :) 但我们说好要保密，所以我不能告诉你 :P{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Futaba, are you cheating on me with my underling?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Futaba，你在和我的手下偷情吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Wouldn’t cheating imply that you and me are dating? :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}偷情的前提不是你我在交往吗？ :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}You know what I mean.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你懂我的意思。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hahaha, of course I know what you mean. And no. I am not cheating on you with Miss Imai. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈哈哈，我当然懂你的意思。没有，我没有和 Imai 老师偷情。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We just found out there’s a little something we have in common. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们只是发现我们之间有那么一点点共同点。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And even though it was a sad conversation, it helped a lot. For me at least.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}虽然那是一场伤感的对话，但它帮了我很多。至少对我来说是。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can’t really tell how she feels, but I hope it was the same for her.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不太说得准她是什么感受，但我希望对她来说也是一样。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m sure it was. Imani’s a good person and I’m glad you two are getting along.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我相信是的。Imani 是个好人，我也很高兴你们两个处得来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Thank you, Sensei :) Me too{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢谢你，Sensei :) 我也是{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just know that if you two ever DO hook up that I would like to be there so I can watch.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你只要知道，如果你们两个真的勾搭上了，我要在场看。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Pervert. Hahah{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}变态。哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Or participate. Whatever is better for you two.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}或者参与进去。看你们两个哪个更合适。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I think Miss Imai is a little more...apprehensive about physical contact with students than you are, Sensei :P{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得 Imai 老师对于和学生有身体接触，要比你……顾虑得多一点，Sensei :P{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, she’s missing out on a great time. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，那她可是错过了天大的好事。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Thank you very much :P I do my best{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}非常感谢 :P 我尽力了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I hope that both of you will continue to take care of me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也希望你们两个能继续好好照顾我。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, maybe until her pants come off and you realize she can’t fuck you the way I do{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，大概会持续到她脱下裤子、而你意识到她没法像我这样操你为止{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh wow O_O{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦哇 O_O{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Wasn’t expecting that hahaha{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没想到你会这么说，哈哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}There’s normally a little more build-up before your perverted side comes out :P{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}平时你的变态一面都会多铺垫一会儿才冒出来的 :P{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, but if Imani is trying to steal you away from me, that means war and I must pull out all the stops.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，但如果 Imani 想把你从我身边抢走，那就意味着开战，我必须使出浑身解数。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And of course the first stop was being horny :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而我打出的第一张牌当然就是发情 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Being horny is my love language.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}发情就是我的爱的语言。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don’t think that’s a love language, Sensei :P You’re probably thinking of physical touch.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得那不是什么爱的语言，Sensei :P 你想的应该是身体接触吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well it’s hard to have sex without that aspect, so I can’t see how I’m in the wrong here.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，少了这一环可是很难做爱的，所以我真看不出自己错在哪儿。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hahah! No, I guess you’re not. But if you’re worried about your penis being the deciding factor in why I have joined Team Imani, fear not. Because that has nothing to do with it :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈哈！是啊，我想你没错。不过如果你担心你的鸡巴会是我加入 Imani 阵营的决定性因素，那大可放心。因为跟那个一点关系都没有 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh, I have no problem with you liking her more. I just reserve the right to be the one who gets to have sex with you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，你更喜欢她我也没意见。我只是保留「和你上床的那个人必须是我」的权利。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}How romantic :P{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}真浪漫啊 :P{/i}

lines.en: : {i}At the end of the day, you’re both wonderful teachers who excel in different things and I greatly appreciate both of you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}说到底，你们两个都是很棒的老师，各有所长，而我也非常感激你们俩。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You’ve done more for my self-esteem than anything else ever has and I’m eternally grateful for that :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你为我的自尊心做的事，比任何事、任何人都多，对此我永远心存感激 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}And Sensei, as a special thank you to you since I know it’s what you want to hear...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有 Sensei，作为给你的特别感谢，因为我知道这就是你想听的……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I love your dick <3 :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我爱你的鸡巴 <3 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Please continue putting it inside of me :D{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}请继续把它插进我里面 :D{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Congratulations on your engagement, Futaba. I’m very happy for you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}恭喜你订婚了，Futaba。我为你感到非常高兴。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Thank you, Sensei. I’ve been waiting my whole life for this and I’m sure I’ll make an excellent bride.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢谢你，Sensei。我等这一天等了一辈子，而且我确信自己会是个出色的新娘。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You two will have beautiful children.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你们两个会有漂亮的孩子。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And we’ll defy all laws of nature in creating them :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而我们会在制造他们的过程中违背一切自然法则 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Jokes aside, I’m not actually getting married. Hahaha{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}玩笑归玩笑，我其实没有要结婚。哈哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Could’ve fooled me with how close the two of you seem to look all of a sudden.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你们两个突然看起来这么亲密，差点就把我骗过去了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes, well...things happened ;){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，那个……发生了一些事 ;){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh{/i}
: {i}That was meant to be a normal smile. I didn’t hit shift. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那个本来想打成普通的笑脸。我按漏了 shift 键。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I promise I’m not suggesting anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我保证我没有在暗示什么。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What sort of “things” happened, Futaba? You’re acting really suspicious right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}到底发生了什么「事」，Futaba？你现在看起来真的很可疑。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I am not! I just missed a button!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我没有！我只是按错了一个键！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}All that happened was a little talk, that’s all. And it turns out that Miss Imai and I aren’t all that different at the end of the day.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}发生的只是小小的聊天而已，就这样。而且到头来才发现，Imai 老师和我并没有那么不同。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I believe that. You’re both extremely attractive and like books.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这我信。你们两个都极有魅力，而且都喜欢书。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hahah! There’s more to us than that, Sensei. But yes, Miss Imai is very pretty.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈哈！我们可不只是这样而已，Sensei。不过是的，Imai 老师很漂亮。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If you say so :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你说是就是吧 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Futaba.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Futaba。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You’re beautiful.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你很美。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If you say soooooo :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你说是就是吧~~~~ :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Stop with the smiles while subtly self-deprecating. It makes me feel like I’m losing this conversation.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别一边发笑脸一边暗暗贬低自己了。那让我觉得自己正在输掉这场对话。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I have to go now :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我得走了 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Byeeeeee :){/i}
